cohort: A total of 400 patients were studied, consisting of 200 normal patients without IUGR and 200 patients with IUGR.
finding: Histopathological observations, including cytotrophoblastic proliferation, fibrinoid necrosis, and hyalinization of villi, are significantly more common and occur earlier in placentas from the IUGR group compared to controls.
mod_finding: The number of LSCS (Caesarean section) deliveries was significantly higher in the IUGR group (59) compared to the control group (33).
